items.title: How to build international two-way SMS with Amazon Connect Customer, Part 1
items.summary: Introduction International two-way SMS with Amazon Connect Customer requires navigating country-specific telecom regulations, origination identity types, and registration processes. Contact centers serving global customers need to reach them via SMS in their local country, but each country has different origination identity types, registration requirements, and two-way messaging capabilities. Amazon Connect Customer natively supports two-way SMS […]
